messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month to visit Hawaii really depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, or price—but most travelers agree that **late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October)** strike the best balance.

| Month | Why it’s great |
|-------|----------------|
| **April** | Warm, sunny weather (average highs 78–84 °F / 26–29 °C). Rainfall is low, and the island crowds are still relatively thin after the winter school‑holiday rush. |
| **May** | Similar weather to April, but with even fewer tourists. Prices for flights and hotels start to dip as the peak summer season approaches. |
| **September** | The summer heat has eased, but temperatures remain comfortable (highs 80–85 °F / 27–29 °C). Rainfall is minimal, and the crowds thin out after the July‑August peak. |
| **October** | Still warm and sunny, with the added bonus of lower hotel rates and fewer visitors. The ocean remains great for snorkeling and surfing. |

### Quick comparison

| Season | Avg. High | Avg. Low | Rainfall | Crowds | Price |
|--------|-----------|----------|----------|--------|-------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | 70–75 °F (21–24 °C) | 57–60 °F (14–16 °C) | 2–3 inches | High (school holidays) | High |
| **Spring (Mar–May)** | 78–84 °F (26–29 °C) | 63–68 °F (17–20 °C) | 1–2 inches | Medium‑low | Medium‑low |
| **Summer (Jun–Aug)** | 84–88 °F (29–31 °C) | 70–73 °F (21–23 °C) | 1–2 inches | High (peak season) | High |
| **Fall (Sep–Nov)** | 80–85 °F (27–29 °C) | 65–70 °F (18–21 °C) | 1–2 inches | Medium‑low | Medium‑low |
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | 70–75 °F (21–24 °C) | 57–60 °F (14–16 °C) | 2–3 inches | High | High |

### Bottom line

- **April–May**: Great weather, fewer crowds, and better deals on accommodations.
- **September–October**: Still warm and sunny, but with even lower prices and fewer tourists.

If you’re a big fan of surfing, the winter months (especially December–January) can offer the best waves, but expect higher prices and more crowds. If you’re looking for the most budget‑friendly trip with pleasant weather, aim for late spring or early fall.
